verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a built-in, live visual Graph of every Object in a Channel and its links, which covers the interactive graph of notes and connections. Nothing in the evidence documents filtering the graph to a chosen subset. Hands-on community reports say the graph becomes useless at hundreds of objects and lacks ways to organize disconnected graphs. missing for 10: documented graph filtering (by type, tag, or query), evidence of usability at scale, independent corroboration of the interactive exploration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can explore my knowledge base as an interactive graph of notes and connections, filtered to what I care about

citations.quote: The Graph is a live, visual map of every Object in your Channel and how they connect to each other.
This relationship is registered in Anytype as a link and becomes visible in your Knowledge Graph—which is a mind map of your entire space.
You can trace how ideas relate, see what's connected to a project
